raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 27 duplicate txn_ids are restated rows: each has a record_version 1 and a record_version 2 copy, and silver_transactions keeps both. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id (ties broken by ingest_ts) and apply the POSTED filter afterwards, so a superseded POSTED version cannot survive when the latest version is REVERSED. This assumes higher record_version means a later correction, which is the usual convention but is not documented here.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
